    const fetchData = async ()=>{
        const token = localStorage.getItem("erp_token");
        if (!token) {

            setError("No authentication token found. Please login again.");

        try {
            const [profileRes, studentsRes, attendanceRes, marksRes, homeworkRes, announcementsRes, timetableRes, complaintsRes, assignmentsRes, datesheetsRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch("/api/erp/profile", {
                    headers: {
                        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`

                }),

                    headers: {
                        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
                    }
                }),
                fetch("/api/erp/assignments", {
                    headers: {
                        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
                    }
                }),
                fetch("/api/erp/datesheets", {
                    headers: {
                        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
                    }
                })
            ]);
            // Handle responses with proper error checking
            const profileData = profileRes.ok ? await profileRes.json() : null;
            const studentsData = studentsRes.ok ? await studentsRes.json() : [];

            const homeworkData = homeworkRes.ok ? await homeworkRes.json() : [];
            const announcementsData = announcementsRes.ok ? await announcementsRes.json() : [];
            const timetableData = timetableRes.ok ? await timetableRes.json() : [];
            const complaintsData = complaintsRes.ok ? await complaintsRes.json() : [];
            const assignmentsData = assignmentsRes.ok ? await assignmentsRes.json() : [];
            const datesheetsData = datesheetsRes.ok ? await datesheetsRes.json() : [];
            if (!profileRes.ok || !profileData) {
                console.error('Profile API failed:', profileRes.status, profileData);
                setError("Failed to load profile. Please check your login and try again.");
                setLoading(false);
                return;
            }
            setProfile(profileData);
            setStudents(Array.isArray(studentsData) ? studentsData : []);
            setAttendance(Array.isArray(attendanceData) ? attendanceData : []);
            setMarks(Array.isArray(marksData) ? marksData : []);

            setTimetable(Array.isArray(timetableData) ? timetableData : []);
            setComplaints(Array.isArray(complaintsData) ? complaintsData : []);
            setAssignments(Array.isArray(assignmentsData) ? assignmentsData : []);
            setDatesheets(Array.isArray(datesheetsData) ? datesheetsData : []);
            // Auto-select teacher's assigned class and section only on initial load
            if (profileData.teacher && profileData.teacher.class_assigned && profileData.teacher.assigned_section) {

                if (!selectedSection) setSelectedSection(profileData.teacher.assigned_section);
                setTeacherSubject(profileData.teacher.subject || "");

            if (!profileRes.ok || !studentsRes.ok || !attendanceRes.ok || !marksRes.ok || !homeworkRes.ok || !announcementsRes.ok || !timetableRes.ok) {

            setStudents([]);
